name: Tay An Pagoda
kicker: Pagoda on the Sam Mountain walk
summary: Pagoda on the Núi Sam walk: see the painted facade and the stupa garden on the same morning as the shrine. Chùa Tây An stands with Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ, the tomb, and the cave pagoda at the foot of the hill. The gate carries the name, and the hill sits behind it. Give it that morning.
getThere: On the Sam Mountain road, with the shrine and the tomb.
heroCaption: The facade of Chùa Tây An, with Núi Sam behind the gate
body: Look at Chùa Tây An on the morning at the foot of Núi Sam. It stands with the shrine, the tomb, and the cave pagoda. The stop is the painted gate, the hill behind it, and the garden of stupas.
The gate carries the name Tây An. Give the pagoda the same morning as the shrine. It is one stop in the cluster.
From the river wards it is about 5 to 7 km, the same road as the rest of Núi Sam.

gettingThere: Chùa Tây An is in the Núi Sam cluster in phường Vĩnh Tế, on the same road as Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ.
